decisions.decision: ID-STABILITY RULE (deviation from the session summary's renumbering sketch, adopted deliberately): task ids (T1.x/T2.x/T3.x/T4.x/T5.x), deliverable ids (D1.x..D5.x) and the surviving WP ids (WP3, WP4, WP5) are NOT renumbered. The WP2 container ceases to exist. Evaluator-facing display numbering (WP1->'WP1', WP3->'WP2', WP4->'WP3', WP5->'WP4', with task/deliverable display ids following) is a presentation mapping recorded once in workpackage_seed.json _provenance.od1_merge_2026_09_02 and applied at drafting/condensation.
decisions.rationale: Renumbering would silently re-target every existing cross-reference (e.g. 'T2.6', 'WP2') across Tier 3, Tier 4 and the plans — silent misreference is the worst failure mode for a 'surgical and deterministic' update. A dangling WP2-container reference is detectable; a re-meaning one is not. KPI->deliverable traces in impacts.json survive unchanged as a direct consequence.
decisions.flag: Operator may veto and request full renumbering; the display mapping keeps the evaluator-facing document contiguous either way.
